```plato
//==
// # Texturing — derived functions for IProceduralTexture
//
// Bodies for the `IProceduralTexture` interface declared in
// `texturing.concepts.plato`: a
// pattern evaluated directly at a UV coordinate via `ColorAt`. The helpers read
// the sampled color's alpha channel for the opacity tests. Pure expressions
// only; all inputs are immutable and evaluation is side-effect free. See
// `CONVENTIONS.md` for the color and UV-origin conventions.

library Texturing
{
    //==
    // # IProceduralTexture
    //
    // A pattern evaluated directly at a UV coordinate via ColorAt. The color's
    // alpha channel drives the opacity helpers.

    // The alpha (opacity) sampled at the UV coordinate, on Color's nominal
    // [0, 1] per-channel scale (color.types.plato). Wide-gamut and HDR samples may
    // exceed 1.
    OpacityAt(self: IProceduralTexture, uv: UvCoordinate): Number
        => self.ColorAt(uv).A;
```
